project.name: ${project.groupId}:${project.artifactId}
project.description: The most widely imported general-purpose utilities: collection-flavored helpers (Lists, Sets, Maps, CollectionUtils, Iterators, CachingList, BigList, NumberList, PrimitiveComparator, and the type-equivalence helpers ClassEquivalent, DelegateEquivalent, UnanonymousType, Isomorphism), string and id utilities (Strings, IntegralStrings, RandomId, BigShort, TidyProperties, SuppliedValue, TaskStack, CacheWheel, CloseableIterator), and NIO channel utilities (ChannelUtils, SharedChannel).
